tasks.name: [איתן | ARCH][MAIN_SESSION] מודל פרופיל/קבוצה/טאב, Session migration ו-ownership
tasks.notes:
STATUS: BACKLOG / PLANNED; no implementation/CI. תכנון מודל StudyProfile -> StudyTabGroup -> ReaderDocumentTab; stable UUIDs, sort order, selection per window, same book allowed in multiple groups, independent locators/scroll and view-model lifecycle. Separate concepts: study profile ≠ production/miniTest10 data profile ≠ Otzaria/Sefaria backend. Existing iOSNavigationManager is @Observable with openTabs and activeTabId; iOSReaderSessionManager stores ios_reader_session.json. Design versioned atomic migration of pre-feature sessions into default 'אישי' + default group, backup/recovery and fail-closed rollback; no deletion/duplication of bookmarks/annotations or production DB. Scene-specific active group/profile, stable session restoration, backend session isolation, rapid switching cancellation. Build an ownership/provenance matrix and exact approval requests for any upstream-owned file or project.pbxproj; protected files stay read-only until approved.
Existing navigation: https://github.com/davidpovarsky/Maktabah/blob/fix/build-8601-ipad-backend-toc-otzaria-index-20261027/Source/UI/iOS/Managers/iOSNavigationManager.swift
Session: https://github.com/davidpovarsky/Maktabah/blob/fix/build-8601-ipad-backend-toc-otzaria-index-20261027/Source/UI/iOS/Managers/iOSReaderSessionManager.swift
Ownership policy: https://github.com/davidpovarsky/Maktabah/blob/fix/build-8601-ipad-backend-toc-otzaria-index-20261027/docs/architecture/UPSTREAM_INTEGRITY_POLICY.md
Acceptance: schema+route contracts, migration fixtures from old sessions, rollback/no-loss tests, multiwindow and backend matrix.
